post.description: Fetch one day's descriptor before downloading it, or look at the first minutes of a day's traffic. The preview is a sample of the start of the day, not of the whole day.

date.description: Day of the file (YYYY-MM-DD, 2015 on). Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

preview.description: Decode the first rows from a 1 MiB Range read (default false).

preview_rows.description:
Rows to return with preview=true (default 100).

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 1000.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
One day's file by date: the descriptor from the year listing (URL, size_bytes, Content-MD5, ETag, Last-Modified, publication_id of the year) and, with preview=true, up to 1,000 rows decoded from the first 1 MiB of the file (one Range request; each file is a single non-seekable zstd frame, so only its prefix can be read inside the runner's limits). Rows are typed per the data dictionary: mmsi, base_date_time (UTC), longitude, latitude, sog, cog, heading, vessel_name, imo (IMO-prefixed, often blank), call_sign, vessel_type, status, length, width, draft, cargo, transceiver (A or B); blank is null and IMO is never inferred.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| `listing_url` | string |  |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `preview` | object |  |
| `record` | object |  |
| `source_url` | string |  |

post.description: Collect the full current list of daily files for a year, then hand the URLs and hashes to a downloader.

continuation.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page's meta.page.next_cursor. It pins the publication; when the year was rewritten since, the call fails with invalid_input at /continuation (issue code publication_changed).

page_size.description:
Records per page (default 100; a year has at most 366).

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 400.

year.description:
Year of the listing (csv2/csv<year>/). 2015 to the current archive year.

Provider reference: minimum 2015; maximum 2100.

200.description:
The daily files of one year as file records (source_record_id ais:<YYYY-MM-DD>, URL, size_bytes, Content-MD5, ETag, Last-Modified, format csv.zst), paged by offset with a cursor pinned to the year's publication hash. Every page re-reads the year listing (one List Blobs call, under 100 KB) and recomputes the hash; a cursor from another publication fails with invalid_input (issue code publication_changed) instead of mixing versions. Segment key: year.

The response contains the tool result directly.

post.description: Before records_list, to learn which years and days exist and to pin a publication; or on a cadence to detect a batch rewrite (the publisher rewrites whole years months after the fact).

year.description:
Year of the listing (csv2/csv<year>/). Default: the newest year prefix in the container.

Provider reference: minimum 2015; maximum 2100.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
Cheap version check of one year's AIS daily-file listing (default: the newest year the archive has). Returns publication_id = SHA-256 of the sorted (blob name, Content-MD5) pairs of the year's csv.zst files, published_at = the newest Last-Modified, the file count and total bytes, the earliest and latest day, the latest file's descriptor (URL, size, Content-MD5, ETag) and the years the archive holds.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `earliest_date` | string |  |
| `file_count` | number | csv.zst files in the year prefix (the per-year index.html blob is excluded). |
| `hash_source` | string |  |
| `index_url` | string | The publisher-written HTML index of the year. |
| `latest_date` | string |  |
| `latest_file` | object |  |
| `listing_url` | string | The List Blobs request the hash was computed from. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `publication_id` | string | SHA-256 over the lines `<blob name>\t<Content-MD5>\n` of the year's csv.zst blobs, sorted by name. |
| `published_at` | string | Newest Last-Modified among the year's files, ISO 8601 UTC. |
| `source_url` | string |  |
| `total_size_bytes` | number |  |
| `year` | number |  |
| `years_available` | number[] | Years with a csv2/csv<year>/ prefix, ascending. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
